items.title: Submit certified degree certificate and transcript (with translations)
items.quote: Please send us officially certified copies of your bachelor's degree certificate and your transcript of records, together with certified German or English translations, so that they reach us by 24 August 2027.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date by which the documents must arrive at the university: 24 August 2027. This is a company/university deadline, not a German-authority letter, so no statutory deemed-delivery or §193 BGB weekend-shift rule applies; the date is a 'must arrive by' date as written. 24 August 2027 is a Tuesday, not a weekend or public holiday, so no shift is needed. Due date = 24 August 2027 (allow for postal transit time, so send well before this date).

warnings: The letter warns that if the certified documents arrive after 24 August 2027, the reserved study place will be given to another applicant — send the documents with enough lead time for postal/courier delivery, not merely postmarked by that date.
Only officially certified copies with certified German or English translations are accepted; scans or uncertified copies will be rejected.
